decided: Jeremy, 2026-11-15 (Q9, dot-contrast sham; relayed by citrus-agent): every chaser carries a hashed role, test or sham; new identity versions semantic v6 + trial_index v5; a missing role hashes as test; every chaser in a pre-v6 recording counts as test
producer: Citrus PR #127 (JohnsonLabJanelia/citrus, branch agent/citrus/chaser-role-v6, draft): code head 04071dd8bf4926ed0d9c7b49f36d251f58ba2d07, fixture head b1391c62440ec0c4b0a5dde32309184d747a88e6, base main 027d292a41db771a6ba14fda7db839c7c1fffec9; rules in src/protocols/chaser_role.h
supersedes: semantic_policy_pairing_v4.json (revision 4). Revisions 2, 3 and 4 are unchanged and stay pinned by whatever already pins them.
hash_rule: protocol_semantic_hash = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical_json_bytes)) over the exact recorded bytes; a consumer never re-canonicalises or regenerates them, except to apply relabel_pooling_rule.rule_v5_to_v6 to recorded v5 bytes
mixing: the trial index version is fixed by the semantic policy: v2, v3 and v4 pair only with trial_index v3, v5 only with trial_index v4, and v6 only with trial_index v5. Any other combination is corruption and is refused. semantic v3-v6 under the legacy convention is refused, and so is an unknown policy (for example citrus.protocol.semantic.v7).

semantic_v6.changes_from_v5: normalization_policy is citrus.protocol.semantic.v6. Every chaser of every chaser step (stimulus_mode_id 12) gains a hashed role. Nothing else changes: the render rate, z_eff_source and v3's chaser fields are kept exactly as in v5.

newly_hashed.rule: required on every chaser of every chaser step, exactly "test" or "sham"; written "test" when the protocol file leaves it out, so a protocol without a sham hashes the same with or without explicit roles; absent from non-chaser steps; ordered by the unchanged canonicaliser

role_rules.definition: a sham is a control arm that is on screen in the step's layout but cannot be seen: it is drawn in exactly the background's displayed code and never moves. It is hashed so that a sham never pools with a test chaser of zero contrast.
role_rules.displayed_code: the plain_v1 code at brightness 1.0 (Citrus ChaserRole::DisplayedCode), recorded in the trial index as features.appearance.elements.chaser_<k>.resolved_color.rgba8 and features.appearance.elements.background.resolved_color.rgba8, where k is the chaser's chaser_index. Never the authored floats (features.bg_color and chasers[k].color are authored codes).

citrus_load_refusals.rule: a sham whose behavior_mode is not passive (1)

a sham with an appearance profile (with or without appearance_drive). appearance_drive without a profile is refused for every chaser, test or sham, by Citrus's general appearance check before roles are checked ("appearance_drive requires an object appearance profile"; protocol_io.cpp ValidateChaserAppearanceConfiguration, unchanged since before v6), so a drive appears in the trial index only under chasers[k].appearance.drive_binding
a sham in a step with background_edge_falloff (the background has no single code)
a sham in a step with enable_proximity_feedback (the per-frame blend toward proximity_color repaints the background under the chasers but not the sham)
a sham in a step whose danger zone is enabled and drawn (danger_zone_enabled && draw_danger_zone; the zone repaints part of the background). An enabled zone with draw_danger_zone false is admitted.
a sham whose displayed rgba8 differs from the background's
a test chaser whose displayed rgba8 equals the background's

role_rules.citrus_order: Citrus reports the first failure in chaser order, and for a sham checks passive, then appearance, then falloff, then proximity feedback, then a drawn danger zone, then the displayed code. Citrus draws the background code, the edge falloff, the proximity blend and the danger zone under the chasers (ChaserStimulus.cu chaser_underlay_pixel), so the sham is refused for each underlay that would make it differ from the pixels around it. A role other than "test" or "sham" is refused with the message 'A chaser's role must be "test" or "sham"' and no stable code.
role_rules.intake_recheck: Palette does not trust Citrus's load check alone. On every v6 recording, for each chaser k of each chaser step in the trial index: R-role, features.chasers[k].role is present and is "test" or "sham"; if "sham": S1, elements.chaser_<k>.resolved_color.rgba8 == elements.background.resolved_color.rgba8; S2, the step's features has no background_edge_falloff; S3, features.chasers[k].behavior_mode_id == 1; S4, features.chasers[k] has no appearance and elements.chaser_<k>.contrast_profile_digest is null; S5, the step's features.proximity_feedback.enabled is false; S6, the step's features.danger_zone is not both enabled and draw true, and elements has no danger_zone (an absent proximity_feedback or danger_zone block counts as enabled); if "test": T1, elements.chaser_<k>.resolved_color.rgba8 != elements.background.resolved_color.rgba8. Any failure refuses the recording. Palette's refusal codes are its own.

trial_index.changes_from_v4: schema_version 4 -> 5 and normalization_policy .v4 -> .v5. On chaser steps every features.chasers[k] gains a required role, "test" or "sham", always written. There are no other new keys. The bytes also differ in the embedded protocol_semantic_hash, and the execution-index hash changes because it embeds the trial-index hash.
trial_index.schema: Citrus src/schemas/protocol_trial_index_v5.schema.json at Citrus PR #127 head b1391c6 (unchanged since 54e475d), sha256 f5f3047d746884ec09e26d414278305f20d1d5b56f2f91630a1e9fb39521c85c (a copy of v4 with $id, title, description and the two version consts changed, and chaser.role added as a required enum test | sham)

semantic_v6.seeds: per_session_v1 chaser seeds are sha256('citrus.chaser_schedule.seed.v1' | session_uuid | semantic_hash | step_index | occurrence), so they change with the semantic hash. session_uuid is included, so no two sessions ever shared a seed. fixed_v1 seeds are unchanged.

relabel_pooling_rule.rule_v5_to_v6: crosswalk. A v5 recording pools with a v6 protocol_semantic_hash group G exactly when 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical(T(v5_bytes)))) == G, where T parses the recorded v5 canonical_json, sets normalization_policy to citrus.protocol.semantic.v6, and sets role "test" on every chaser of every chaser step (stimulus_mode_id 12), and canonical is sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), UTF-8, no NaN. Only recorded v5 bytes are used; the v5 trial index is read with every chaser as role "test". The render rate is part of the identity, so 120 and 240 Hz never pool with each other.
relabel_pooling_rule.why: v6 adds only a label. Every pre-v6 chaser was a test chaser, so a v5 recording shows exactly the stimulus of its v6 counterpart with all roles test. No v5 recording can join a group that contains a sham.
relabel_pooling_rule.zero_contrast_v5: a v5 chaser drawn in the background's displayed code would be refused by v6 Citrus (chaser_role_test_equals_background), so its T-image names no admissible v6 protocol and it pools with no v6 group. It keeps its own v5 hash. None of the six fixture protocols has one.
relabel_pooling_rule.earlier_rules: the revision-2 (v2 to v3) and revision-3 (v3 to v4) rules are unchanged and end at v4; rule_v4_to_v5 stays none

h5: none. Revision 5 adds no H5 group or attribute; role is only in the protocol identity and the trial index.
